operations.title: Entry 1214 — The Five-Site Endpoint Kummer Line Is the d=5 Coefficient Sector
operations.summary: Primary-source equation (3.10) gives the five-edge CM measure exponent (d-6)/2. The square-root endpoint period of Entries 1211-1212 is therefore the d=5 analytically continued coefficient sector. In physical d=3 the exponent is -3/2 and only three edge variables are independent, so the rank-constrained source current remains unconstructed. Generic branch geometry in Entries 1207-1210 survives.

operations.title: Benincasa corrects the five-site Kummer line to the d=5 coefficient sector
operations.body: Primary-source audit of arXiv:2402.06558 eq. (3.10) forces a scope correction. For n_e=5 the CM exponent is (d-6)/2. Our dz/sqrt(P) endpoint period is d=5, not physical d=3. At d=3 the exponent is -3/2 and the source says only three of five edge variables are independent. Entries 1207-1210 remain valid generic coefficient geometry; Entries 1211-1212 are now explicitly restricted to the d=5 analytic coefficient sector. The next legitimate object is the source-derived rank-constrained d=3 five-site current with all five occurrence labels retained.
